verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents a public REST API for setting up and scaling pipelines and managing the account programmatically, with a getting-started guide (including Connect Cards). API access is listed as a plan feature, and an official MCP server wraps these operations with scoped read, write and delete access. One community user reports that the APIs fail randomly, but this is a general reliability complaint rather than a concrete counter-example, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), endpoint-level reference detail in the evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration of API reliability.
